entries.188455d84f6f1f9f: This is the domestic business. Mazda Motor Corporation makes automobiles and parts at the Head Office Plant in Fuchu-cho, Aki-gun, Hiroshima Prefecture, the Hofu Plant in Hofu, Yamaguchi Prefecture and elsewhere, and sales companies such as Kanto Mazda Co., Ltd. and Tokai Mazda Sales Co., Ltd. sell them to customers. The company sells directly to some large customers. Because automobiles produced in Japan are also shipped to overseas sales companies, in the fiscal year ended March 2026 there were intersegment internal sales of ¥2,457,705 million against sales to external customers of ¥900,173 million.
entries.460503d68702746d: Customers who buy automobiles in Australia, Thailand, China and other countries
entries.4f51e3139396e800: This is the business in regions other than Japan, North America and Europe, which the company manages centrally as 1 management unit. Sales are made by Mazda Australia Pty.Ltd., Mazda Sales (Thailand) Co., Ltd. and others, and production is handled by the equity-method affiliate Auto Alliance (Thailand) Co., Ltd., Changan Mazda Automobile Co., Ltd. of China and others.
entries.56721de21a92cdd2: Customers who buy automobiles in North America
entries.a5d300716dcfe0c4: A manufacturer that makes passenger cars and automotive parts at plants in Hiroshima and Yamaguchi, among others, and sells them worldwide, mainly in North America and Europe.
entries.aa8a57c177bd94e8: This is the North American business, managed by Mazda Motor of America, Inc. and the company.
entries.af6a50a71405f883: This is the European business, managed by Mazda Motor Europe GmbH and the company. Sales companies such as Mazda Motors (Deutschland) GmbH and Mazda Motors UK Ltd. sell automobiles and parts, and Mazda Motor Logistics Europe N.V. handles logistics.
entries.bf4095da4df53ad8: Customers who buy automobiles in Europe
entries.de5696a5db2fcecd: This is the European business, managed by Mazda Motor Europe GmbH and the company.
entries.e148cbc5bcb90e2a: The business in regions other than Japan, North America and Europe, which the company manages centrally as one management unit.
entries.e722287586e392d9: Customers who buy automobiles in Japan
entries.e936f51c810cb4df: This is the North American business, managed by Mazda Motor of America, Inc. and the company. The business sells automobiles and parts in the United States; for the fiscal year ended March 2026 its revenue was ¥1,946,008 million, which exceeds 10% of consolidated revenue. In Mexico, Mazda Motor Manufacturing de Mexico S.A. de C.V. manufactures automobiles, and in Canada, Mazda Canada, Inc. sells them.
